item.tib: gsang sngags kyi mchod sgrub kyi skabs su 'phring chog smon lam gdab par bya ba 'brug chen tshangs dbyangs
item.coloph: ces gsang sngags kyi smon lam 'brug chen sgrogs pa'i sgra rgyal tshangs dbyangs zhes bya ba dmu rigs nyi ma'i ming chen gyis 'bring 'tshams mtha' dkar gshen gyi gzim khang du brtsams pa dge'o//
